# Country scope: gold reserve in months of total income.
pp_cplan_reserve_months = {

	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_cplan_reserve }
		value = var:pp_cplan_reserve
		subtract = 100
	}
}

# Country scope: the province focus count, for the panel's cycle (bands + hands off + custom).
pp_cplan_focus_count = { value = 6 }
# Country scope: farm sites tried per province.
pp_cplan_farm_sites = { value = 4 }

# Province scope: the focus id (1 = the first preset, also when nothing is set; 1 standard, 2 breadbasket, 3 market_town, 4 workshop, 5 hands_off, 6 custom).
pp_cplan_focus_n = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_cplan_focus }
		value = var:pp_cplan_focus
		subtract = 100
	}
}

# Province scope: 1 where the province is set to Hands off.
pp_cplan_hands_off_n = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_cplan_focus }
		if = {
			limit = { var:pp_cplan_focus > 104.5 var:pp_cplan_focus < 105.5 }
			value = 1
		}
	}
}
# Any scope: the Custom focus id + 100 and the last focus id + 100 (the cycle wraps after it).
pp_cplan_custom_id100 = { value = 106 }
pp_cplan_focus_last100 = { value = 106 }

# Province scope: the focus band (build below, stored months). No focus set = the first preset.
pp_cplan_band_lo = {
	value = 6
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_cplan_focus }
		if = {
			limit = { var:pp_cplan_focus > 100.5 var:pp_cplan_focus < 101.5 }
			value = 6
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:pp_cplan_focus > 101.5 var:pp_cplan_focus < 102.5 }
			value = 8
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:pp_cplan_focus > 102.5 var:pp_cplan_focus < 103.5 }
			value = 6
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:pp_cplan_focus > 103.5 var:pp_cplan_focus < 104.5 }
			value = 4
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:pp_cplan_focus > 105.5 has_variable = pp_cplan_lo }
			value = var:pp_cplan_lo
			subtract = 100
		}
	}
}
# Province scope: the focus band (stop above, stored months). No focus set = the first preset.
pp_cplan_band_hi = {
	value = 18
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_cplan_focus }
		if = {
			limit = { var:pp_cplan_focus > 100.5 var:pp_cplan_focus < 101.5 }
			value = 18
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:pp_cplan_focus > 101.5 var:pp_cplan_focus < 102.5 }
			value = 20
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:pp_cplan_focus > 102.5 var:pp_cplan_focus < 103.5 }
			value = 14
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:pp_cplan_focus > 103.5 var:pp_cplan_focus < 104.5 }
			value = 12
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:pp_cplan_focus > 105.5 has_variable = pp_cplan_hi }
			value = var:pp_cplan_hi
			subtract = 100
		}
	}
}

# A wheat farm here: the line's local output (+ 1 = 1 %), much more where the line already stands.
pp_cplan_farm_score_wheat = {
	value = 100
	add = { value = modifier:local_wheat_output_modifier multiply = 100 }
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { has_building = building_type:wheat_farm has_building = building_type:wheat_farmstead has_building = building_type:wheat_rotations has_building = building_type:wheat_model_farm } }
		add = 1000
	}
	min = 1
}

		limit = { OR = { has_building = building_type:ablaq_palace has_building = building_type:regulated_sericulture_farm has_building = building_type:sericulture_farm has_building = building_type:silk_production_guild } }
		add = 1000
	}
	min = 1
}

# chili: Country scope: the mode (0 off, 1 keep stocked, 2 expand while profitable, 3 never).
pp_cplan_mode_chili = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_cplan_g_chili }
		value = var:pp_cplan_g_chili
		subtract = 100
	}
}
# Location scope: months of the market's demand its stock holds (99 where nobody asks for it).
pp_cplan_months_chili = {
	value = 99
	if = {
		limit = { market ?= { "goods_demand_in_market(goods:chili)" > 0.01 } }
		value = "market.stockpile_in_market(goods:chili)"
		divide = "market.goods_demand_in_market(goods:chili)"
	}
	max = 99
}
# Country scope: the same for the capital's market (the panel).
pp_cplan_cap_months_chili = {
	value = 0
	capital ?= { add = pp_cplan_months_chili }
	max = 99
}
# Location scope: where to build first (output modifier, standing producers far first).
pp_cplan_site_chili = {
	value = 100
	add = { value = modifier:local_chili_output_modifier multiply = 100 }
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { has_building = building_type:chili_plantation } }
		add = 1000
	}
	min = 1
}

		limit = { OR = { has_building = building_type:lumber_mill has_building = building_type:lumber_mill_improved has_building = building_type:shoen has_building = building_type:water_sawmill } }
		add = 1000
	}
	min = 1
}

# fish: Country scope: the mode (0 off, 1 keep stocked, 2 expand while profitable, 3 never).
pp_cplan_mode_fish = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_cplan_g_fish }
		value = var:pp_cplan_g_fish
		subtract = 100
	}
}
# Location scope: months of the market's demand its stock holds (99 where nobody asks for it).
pp_cplan_months_fish = {
	value = 99
	if = {
		limit = { market ?= { "goods_demand_in_market(goods:fish)" > 0.01 } }
		value = "market.stockpile_in_market(goods:fish)"
		divide = "market.goods_demand_in_market(goods:fish)"
	}
	max = 99
}
# Country scope: the same for the capital's market (the panel).
pp_cplan_cap_months_fish = {
	value = 0
	capital ?= { add = pp_cplan_months_fish }
	max = 99
}
# Location scope: where to build first (output modifier, standing producers far first).
pp_cplan_site_fish = {
	value = 100
	add = { value = modifier:local_fish_output_modifier multiply = 100 }
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { has_building = building_type:drift_net_fishery has_building = building_type:fishing_village has_building = building_type:net_curing_yard has_building = building_type:ocean_fishery has_building = building_type:offshore_fishery } }
		add = 1000
	}
	min = 1
}

pp_cplan_mode_furniture = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_cplan_g_furniture }
		value = var:pp_cplan_g_furniture
		subtract = 100
	}
}
# Location scope: months of the market's demand its stock holds (99 where nobody asks for it).
pp_cplan_months_furniture = {
	value = 99
	if = {
		limit = { market ?= { "goods_demand_in_market(goods:furniture)" > 0.01 } }
		value = "market.stockpile_in_market(goods:furniture)"
		divide = "market.goods_demand_in_market(goods:furniture)"
	}
	max = 99
}
# Country scope: the same for the capital's market (the panel).
pp_cplan_cap_months_furniture = {
	value = 0
	capital ?= { add = pp_cplan_months_furniture }
	max = 99
}
# Location scope: where to build first (output modifier, standing producers far first).
pp_cplan_site_furniture = {
	value = 100
	add = { value = modifier:local_furniture_output_modifier multiply = 100 }
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { has_building = building_type:furniture_guild has_building = building_type:furniture_manufactory has_building = building_type:furniture_mill has_building = building_type:furniture_workshop } }
		add = 1000
	}
	min = 1
}

# Location scope: where to build first (output modifier, standing producers far first).
pp_cplan_site_alum = {
	value = 100
	add = { value = modifier:local_alum_output_modifier multiply = 100 }
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { has_building = building_type:alum_quarry has_building = building_type:alum_works } }
		add = 1000
	}
	min = 1
}

# mercury: Country scope: the mode (0 off, 1 keep stocked, 2 expand while profitable, 3 never).
pp_cplan_mode_mercury = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_cplan_g_mercury }
		value = var:pp_cplan_g_mercury
		subtract = 100
	}
}
# Location scope: months of the market's demand its stock holds (99 where nobody asks for it).
pp_cplan_months_mercury = {
	value = 99
	if = {
		limit = { market ?= { "goods_demand_in_market(goods:mercury)" > 0.01 } }
		value = "market.stockpile_in_market(goods:mercury)"
		divide = "market.goods_demand_in_market(goods:mercury)"
	}
	max = 99
}
# Country scope: the same for the capital's market (the panel).
pp_cplan_cap_months_mercury = {
	value = 0
	capital ?= { add = pp_cplan_months_mercury }
	max = 99
}
# Location scope: where to build first (output modifier, standing producers far first).

	value = 100
	add = { value = modifier:local_mercury_output_modifier multiply = 100 }

		limit = { OR = { has_building = building_type:cinnabar_pit has_building = building_type:quicksilver_retort } }
		add = 1000
	}
	min = 1
}
